about_the_game:
• Digital Artbook: Inspired by steampunk circus posters from the turn of the 20th century, Zen Studios set out to make one of the most unique role-playing games ever developed. Full of beautiful concept art as well as interesting tidbits about the game’s development, this artbook offers unique insight into the game’s production.
• Game Maps: Six challenging districts await you in Circus Electrique. Plot your path wisely with these digital maps.
